text_block_list.text: Hearing Air Groove was supervising student dance lessons after school, I slipped in to watch.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Maintain formation! Turn immediately following that step! 
Snap your head around with purpose!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Yes, senpai!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A single missed beat is fatal! 
Next, the heel step! Front row, ready!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Yes, senpai!

Strict tone, yet precise and efficient instruction. 
A dance lesson conducted exactly in character for Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Next, synchronization practice! 
Split into two groups instantly and execute the sequence!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirls
text_block_list.text: Understood!
choice_data_list: It's a pretty high level program.
It's a pretty high level program.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you. 
...So you were watching.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A flawless Winning Live defines a true Umamusume. 
Conditioning your body through repetition enables—

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text: To think we're getting direct guidance from Air Groove-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text:
We can't show her an embarrassing routine! 
Give it everything we've got!
Overeager, the underclassmen quickly lost their balance—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Lapse in focus there and you'll— Look out!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text: Kyaah!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!
Air Groove threw herself forward to shield her junior...!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text: Oww...

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Uwaah?! 
Air Groove-senpai! Senpai, are you alright?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I am fine. Cease making a scene over nothing.

Though clearly hurt from the fall, Air Groove insisted she was fine. 
I managed to talk her into visiting the infirmary.

Diagnosis: mild sprain. 
Minor swelling, but fortunately zero damage to ligaments or bone.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If that is all, there is no issue. 
I am returning to practice. Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Why bar my path? My juniors are waiting. 
Guiding them is my responsibility.
choice_data_list: You have to take better care of yourself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Myself? I manage my own condition strictly. 
You have zero authority to dictate orders here.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
An "Empress" bears the obligation to lead those beneath her. Demanding I abandon that is absurd. 
A trifling scratch like this—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! You are standing far too close! 
Maintain appropriate personal space when addressing me!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Cease making such a pathetic face. 
Good grief, you are utterly impossible...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fine... 
...Haa.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I will stand down for today. 
I must apologize to the underclassmen and reschedule their instruction.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The stature I pursue is that of the absolute ideal for all Umamusume—the "Empress"—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Causing excessive anxiety to my Trainer hardly reflects an ideal leader.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Discussion concluded! 
Since the matter is settled, I will rest properly.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I said I am going to sleep. 
How long do you intend to stand there staring?
After chasing me out of the room, Air Groove finally allowed herself to rest.
